assumptions: Submitted boundary is provisional; recalculate after official polygon replacement.

floor_area_ratio.reason: Approved FAR controls and official site boundary are not present in the public site package.

assumptions: Populate only after a real pilot establishes the touchpoint register and review method.
easy_read_coverage_rate.reason: No real pilot has established a baseline or approved threshold.
easy_read_coverage_rate.decision_use: Do not expand a pilot below the approved coverage threshold.

assumptions: Use representative service tasks and publish the sampling method.
no_phone_service_completion_rate.reason: No representative service-task sample or observed baseline is available.
no_phone_service_completion_rate.decision_use: Detect digital exclusion and size offline/human service capacity.

assumptions: Measure against a published service-level promise.
human_takeover_availability_rate.reason: No operating service-level promise or observed takeover log is available.
human_takeover_availability_rate.decision_use: Repeated failure suspends high-risk AI service.

assumptions: A complete passport contains source/version, use, scope, time, rights, limits, reviewer, correction channel and removal condition.
provenance_passport_completeness_rate.reason: No public-output sample has been produced by an operating pilot.
provenance_passport_completeness_rate.decision_use: Incomplete public content is removed until evidence is repaired.

assumptions: Closure requires reporter-visible verification, not internal status change alone.
median_issue_closure_hours.reason: No operating issue ledger exists from which to calculate closure time.
median_issue_closure_hours.decision_use: Expose maintenance congestion and ownership gaps.

assumptions: Drills cover service shutdown, data deletion or sealing, human fallback and public notice.
stoppable_pilot_compliance_rate.reason: No active pilot has completed the defined shutdown and fallback drill.
stoppable_pilot_compliance_rate.decision_use: No pilot moves to routine operation without a completed drill.

assumptions: Participation must be voluntary, compensated where appropriate and recorded without health profiling.
accessibility_cotest_participation_rate.reason: No accessibility co-test cohort or eligible-scene register exists yet.
accessibility_cotest_participation_rate.decision_use: Under-tested scenes return to design before public expansion.

assumptions: Exclude closed, paywalled or commercially reserved periods.
protected_public_hours_delivery_rate.reason: No operating calendar exists to compare promised and delivered public hours.
protected_public_hours_delivery_rate.decision_use: Prevent commercial activity from displacing public access.
